scholarships.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
scholarships.degree: Graduate (Master's, JD, MBA, MD, MFA, MS, DMA, PhD, and joint/dual degrees)

existing.description: A fellowship applied directly to cover tuition and associated fees
eligibility: All citizens and residents of all countries (no nationality restrictions).
Hold equivalent of U.S. bachelor's degree from recognized institution.
Must apply to and be admitted to a Stanford graduate degree program.
No quotas by discipline, program, or world region.
existing.eligibility_summary: All citizens and residents of all countries; no restrictions by age, field of study, or career aspiration; must apply to a Stanford graduate degree program; must demonstrate leadership, independence, and civic-mindedness.
benefits: Fellowship applied directly to cover tuition and associated fees for up to three years
Stipend for living and academic expenses (room, board, books, supplies, local transportation, personal expenses)
Annual travel stipend for one round-trip economy ticket to and from Stanford
coverage: Fellowship applied directly to cover tuition and associated fees for up to three years
Stipend for living and academic expenses (room, board, books, supplies, local transportation, personal expenses)
Annual travel stipend for one round-trip economy ticket to and from Stanford
requirements: Submit the KHS application by October 6, 2026, 1:00 pm Pacific Time
Submit a completely separate Stanford graduate degree application by the earlier of the programme's KHS deadline or December 1, 2026
Pay any application fee required by the Stanford graduate programme; KHS charges no application fee and cannot provide degree-programme fee waivers
Submit recommendation letters and test scores after the deadline if necessary, provided your own application is submitted on time
documents: Stanford graduate degree program application (separate process)
existing.english_requirement: English proficiency as required by Stanford graduate program; TOEFL/IELTS may be required depending on program.
application_method: Apply to Knight-Hennessy Scholars program (separate from Stanford graduate application)
Must also apply to and be admitted to a Stanford graduate degree program
existing.selection_notes: There is no formula for admission. Applicants are evaluated on independence of thought, purposeful leadership and a civic mindset. Video statement invitations are sent on a rolling basis through January, finalists are notified on January 27, 2027, and scholars on March 16, 2027.
existing.best_fit: Exceptional graduate students from around the world seeking fully funded study and leadership development at Stanford.
existing.notes: Fully endowed program; funding applies to degree program listed in initial admission letter. Scholars participate in King Global Leadership Program. No requirement for institutional endorsement. Highly competitive (~80-100 scholars selected per cohort).
existing.duration: Up to three years of funding, depending on degree length (1-3 years; 1-2 years for MA/MBA/MFA/MPP/MS/JSM/MLS/LLM)
existing.application_period: Annual cohort selection; 2027 cohort applications open
existing.program_type: Postgraduate interdisciplinary leadership fellowship for full-time Stanford graduate degree enrollees
